concept: Spinner says a device is busy and has no figure to show yet, such as a hub answering or a firmware file loading. It is a small field of recessed holes with a short lit trail that walks round the edge, and it exists only while the work runs.

default_to_avoid.pattern: circular spinner, a ring with a coloured arc that turns for ever
default_to_avoid.why_not: The coloured arc spends the unit's one orange on a wait, and a smooth endless turn is the idle motion P6 forbids, so the busy motion steps hole by hole and exists only while the work runs.

default_to_avoid.pattern: three bouncing dots in the brand colour
default_to_avoid.why_not: Bouncing dots have no recess and no state beyond moving, so a person who asks for reduced motion is left with nothing that says busy.

references.source: Braun LE 1 loudspeaker (Dieter Rams, 1959): a field of round holes in the case that is read as one pattern
Braun ET 66 calculator (Dietrich Lubs, 1987): a segment turns on and off in its window and nothing else moves
system/FORM.md display class: grille is a field of recessed holes whose lit holes are the reading

derivation.consequence: each hole is a recess (inverse light), never a printed dot
derivation.form: The nine holes take the same recess and well shadow as Grille, so a Spinner reads as a grille that is working, not as a new drawing.

derivation.consequence: grille pitch is one module step, so holes sit on the same grid as the body's inset
derivation.form: Holes are three by three on Grille's pitch, so the Spinner stands on the same grid as the controls beside it and the larger size is a whole step bigger.

derivation.consequence: holes are ink at a lower step; a lit level uses ink at full step, never orange
derivation.form: Unlit holes use the lower step and the lit trail uses full ink, so the trail keeps 3:1 against the unlit holes in both themes and nothing is orange.

derivation.consequence: a level change fills holes in reading order, ≤120ms, none under Reduce motion
derivation.form: The trail moves one hole per motion.fill step (120ms) in reading order round the edge; under reduce motion it stops on a fixed trail of three lit holes.
Busy is a state, so the Spinner is mounted only while the work runs and has no motion before or after; nothing else in the unit moves with it.

derivation.consequence: a grille that shows a value exposes it as text to assistive tech
derivation.form: The Spinner is a status region that holds its label as text, so the busy state is announced in words and the holes are hidden from assistive tech.

options.name: lit trail walking the edge of a three by three field
one lit hole scanning along a row of five
round field filling from the bottom row up

variants.reason: A is still a readable pattern when reduce motion stops it, because three lit holes in a ring show a direction, and it stays small enough to stand beside a key. B freezes to one lit hole that says nothing, and C is a 21-hole field as tall as a Display, too heavy for a wait.

root.why: The root is a status region that holds the label as text and the field of holes, so a wait is announced in words.

field.why: The field lays nine holes in three columns on Grille's one module pitch, and mirrors in right-to-left layouts.

hole.why: Each hole is a recess in the lower ink step with the well shadow, and the eight on the edge take the trail in turn.

still.why: Under reduce motion the first three holes of the ring stay in full ink, so a stopped Spinner still shows a short trail.

text.why: The label is real text inside the status region, hidden from sight unless asked for, so announcement never depends on the holes.

shown.why: A shown label is printed beside the field on the inset line, in the label size with a line box tall enough for Thai marks.

sm.why: The small size uses Grille's 8px holes, the same size as a Grille beside it in a list row.

md.why: The medium size uses holes one module step larger, for a Spinner that stands alone in a sheet or a card.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduce motion the trail does not move and three holes stay lit in a ring, so busy is a pattern and not a movement.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours each hole keeps a real border and a lit hole fills with the text colour, so the trail and the still pattern both survive.

@walk.why: Each hole lights for three steps of 120ms in turn round the ring, a stepped change with no easing, and the loop runs only while the Spinner is mounted.
